mine.title: My Certificates
mine.subtitle: An ownership certificate for each of your holdings — view it, download the official PDF, or share its verification link.
mine.loadError: We could not load your certificates. Please try again.
mine.emptyText: A certificate is issued automatically as soon as a purchase is paid. It becomes final once your shares are delivered.
mine.pdfError: The PDF could not be created. Please try again.

statusHint.provisional: Payment confirmed — becomes final once the shares are delivered on-chain or the plan is fully paid.
statusHint.final: Valid — the shares are delivered and recorded.
statusHint.revoked: No longer valid — the holding changed or ended.

details.registry: Look up in the Wyoming registry

verify.title: Certificate verification
verify.subtitle: Check that a Capimax RT ownership certificate is genuine and see what it certifies.
verify.notFoundText: No certificate matches this code. Check the code on the certificate, or scan its QR code again.
verify.genuine: Genuine certificate issued by Capimax RT
verify.error: The check could not be completed. Please try again.

center.title: Verification Center
center.subtitle: Everything you need to check your ownership independently: your certificates, the companies that own the properties, and the token contracts on the blockchain.
center.certText: Enter the verification code or certificate ID printed on a certificate, or scan its QR code.
center.registryText: Each property is owned by a company registered with the Wyoming Secretary of State. Search the official registry by company name or filing ID, and check the property's token contract on the blockchain explorer.
center.registryEmpty: No company records are published yet.
center.trustText: Documents issued across the Capimax ecosystem — including by valuation firms, insurers, legal advisors and auditors — can be verified on Capimax Trust.
